verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own pages say it supports reviewing pull requests on the go, including commenting, approving and merging in the app. A hands-on community report confirms people do code review in it, though with usability friction. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on review mechanics (inline comments, request-changes, per-file diff navigation), better diff readability on small screens (line wrapping makes review harder per hands-on report), push notification when assigned as reviewer.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review pull requests from my phone while on the go

citations.quote: Whether you're reviewing a bug fix or merging code, we've got you covered. From your daily commute to grabbing a coffee, unblock your team on the go.
Use comments to refine, iterate, approve and merge—all directly within GitHub Mobile.
Still an improvement over mobile web, where the PR approve button was hard to hit.
